title: Greenhouse effect and climate change
quote: Natural effect: water vapour biggest; enhanced effect: CO2 biggest

boxes.title: How the greenhouse effect works
steps: GHGs absorb and re-radiate, partly back down

boxes.title: Natural vs enhanced
head: Natural
Enhanced
rows: No human role; keeps Earth habitable

boxes.title: GHG facts & traps
items: Enhanced share: **CO2 60%** > CH4 **20%** > CFCs **15%** > N2O **5%**
Not GHGs: **N2, O2, Ar** (APPSC 2025), SO2, hydrogen
Synthetic: **CFCs, HFCs, PFCs, SF6**; perfluoromethane from aluminium
==Deforestation **increases** CO2== (APPSC 2025 trap)
SLCPs: **black carbon**, methane, HFCs, tropospheric ozone
Black carbon: incomplete combustion; darkens snow and ice

boxes.title: Data & impacts
items: CO2 **423.9 ppm** (2024), up **3.5 ppm**: largest rise since **1957**
vs pre-industrial: CO2 **152%**, CH4 **266%**, N2O **125%**
==**2024**: first calendar year above **1.5°C**==
Oceans took **over 90%** of extra energy
Top emitters: **China 12**, USA **4.9**, **India 3.2** Gt (3rd)
Arctic sea ice down **3.5-4.1%** per decade

boxes.title: Pledges & projections
items: **Global Methane Pledge** (COP26, **2021**): **30%** cut by **2030**; ==India not signed==
UNEP Emissions Gap **2025**: **2.3-2.5°C** even with NDCs
**425** carbon bombs (LINGO); India: **Gevra**, **Rajmahal**
India's social cost of carbon: **$86** per tonne, highest

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Primary cause of global warming = ==increase in GHGs== (APPSC 2025)
Water vapour = most important GHG; humans raise it only **indirectly** (APPSC 2023)
Global warming → **rising sea levels**; air pollution → respiratory illness
Black carbon = short-lived, incomplete combustion (APPSC 2025)
Paddy → **methane**; fertilisers → **N2O**
